item.darkwinter.asphalt_block.descriptio: Dark, grainy road surfacing. A level piece of a familiar route among earth and snow.
item.darkwinter.asphalt_crosswalk.descri: Broad pale stripes marking a pedestrian crossing. A place where looking both ways is second nature.
item.darkwinter.asphalt_dashed_line.desc: Broken markings on rough asphalt. Their short rhythm is familiar from long drives.
item.darkwinter.asphalt_edge_line.descri: A pale stripe along the asphalt's edge. The final neat line before the uneven verge.
item.darkwinter.asphalt_white_line.descr: A pale solid stripe across dark asphalt. A simple trace of road order, even when no traffic comes.
item.darkwinter.bedside_cabinet.descript: A small cabinet for the things kept close to a bed. Plain furniture with a very personal purpose.
item.darkwinter.boulder_large.descriptio: A massive granite boulder with uneven faces. It looks as though no weather ever lasts long enough to matter.
item.darkwinter.boulder_small.descriptio: A low granite stone with a rough surface. An ordinary part of northern ground, easily overlooked beneath snow.
item.darkwinter.bus_shelter.description: A small bus shelter with a roof. A familiar waiting place where the day's missing routine feels especially clear.
item.darkwinter.bus_stop_sign.descriptio: A bus stop sign on a slender post. One glance is enough to make you listen for an engine out of habit.
item.darkwinter.cable_spool.description: A broad wooden spool wound with cable. The familiar shape of a sizeable job waiting beside a wall.
item.darkwinter.camp_cooking_pot.descrip: A compact metal pot with a bail handle. Plain cookware that belongs among a traveller's few possessions.
item.darkwinter.camp_wide_pot.descriptio: A broad camp pot with low sides. Its plain shape brings to mind a meal shared beside a fire.
item.darkwinter.canned_beans.description: Beans beneath a tin lid. A familiar provision for pantries, camp bags and unhurried suppers.
item.darkwinter.canned_fish.description: A small tin of fish with a closed lid. An ordinary shelf item that stands out far from any shop.
item.darkwinter.canned_meat.description: Canned meat in a plain tin. The unassuming shape of supplies remembered far from a kitchen.
item.darkwinter.canvas_canteen.descripti: A field canteen in a coarse canvas cover. Its rounded shape is familiar among belongings packed for the road.
item.darkwinter.cardboard_boxes.descript: Several cardboard boxes with square folds. The sort left by a move, a delivery or an ordinary clear-out.
item.darkwinter.carpenter_tool_tote.desc: An open wooden tote with a raised handle. A plain carpenter's shape that needs no ornament.
item.darkwinter.cattail_clump.descriptio: Long narrow leaves and dense brown heads. Cattails keep their unmistakable outline close to the water.
item.darkwinter.cattail_rhizome.descript: A thick, knotted rhizome with fine roots. The part of a cattail usually hidden in damp ground.
item.darkwinter.concrete_bollard.descrip: A low, solid concrete bollard. A simple street obstacle that needs little explanation.
item.darkwinter.concrete_curb.descriptio: A concrete edge between road and verge. A low line that still reveals the shape of a street.
item.darkwinter.concrete_planter.descrip: A solid concrete planter with a broad rim. It is easy to picture summer in it, despite everything around it.
item.darkwinter.concrete_steps.descripti: A short run of straight-edged concrete steps. The familiar transition from street to doorstep.
item.darkwinter.control_console.descript: An angled industrial control console. Its rows of controls suggest work once learned by heart.
item.darkwinter.cracker_box.description: A light cardboard box of dry crackers. Plain travelling provisions without ceremony.
item.darkwinter.cranberry_patch.descript: Low cranberry shoots bearing red berries. Bright dots held close to the cold ground.
item.darkwinter.cranberry_patch_no_berri: Low cranberry shoots without red berries. A familiar plant now easily missed at a glance.
item.darkwinter.dining_table.description: A broad dining table on wooden legs. It is easy to picture plates, conversation and one unoccupied chair around it.
item.darkwinter.drain_grate.description: A metal grate with narrow slots. A small dark detail underfoot, made with very different weather in mind.
item.darkwinter.dry_grass_tuft.descripti: Stiff dry stems gather in a small tuft. A quiet trace of a season that ended before this walk began.
item.darkwinter.electrical_cabinet.descr: A closed metal cabinet for electrical equipment. Outside, there is little more than a plain case and a door.
item.darkwinter.examination_table.descri: A raised examination table on a sturdy frame. Its shape favours the work at hand over comfort.
item.darkwinter.fallen_road_barrier.desc: A road barrier lying on its side. No longer upright across the route, its familiar shape still catches the eye.
item.darkwinter.fallen_spruce_log.descri: A fallen spruce trunk with uneven bark. A forest's upright line now lying among the ground cover.
item.darkwinter.fire_hydrant.description: A squat fire hydrant with side outlets. Its solid outline looks stubbornly familiar on an empty street.
item.darkwinter.firewood_crib.descriptio: Firewood stacked beneath a low metal cover. A neat pile that looks very much like someone's foresight.
item.darkwinter.floor_segment.descriptio: A level floor section of spruce boards. A plain timber pattern familiar from rooms and workshops.
item.darkwinter.folded_newspaper.descrip: A newspaper folded several times. Its crowded columns still recall the bustle of ordinary days.
item.darkwinter.forest_branch_pile.descr: Tangled spruce branches lie in a low heap. Their angular shape belongs to the disorder of the forest floor.
item.darkwinter.forest_fern.description: The spreading, feathered fronds of a forest fern. A delicate shape among the harsher lines of the woods.
item.darkwinter.forest_root_cluster.desc: Interwoven spruce roots run close to the ground. The visible part of what held a tree in place for years.
item.darkwinter.forest_trail_marker.desc: A wooden marker beside a forest trail. Someone else's brief guidance in a place where direction is easily lost.
item.darkwinter.frozen_window.descriptio: Frosted glass set in a spruce frame. Even the window's outline recalls the weather beyond the wall.
item.darkwinter.frozen_window_dark.descr: Frost-covered glass in a dark frame. The contrast of timber and pale glass makes the cold especially noticeable.
item.darkwinter.frozen_window_gray.descr: Frozen glass in a pale wooden frame. The light timber nearly merges with the frost's pattern.
item.darkwinter.fuel_jerrycan.descriptio: A steel fuel can with reinforced sides and a top handle. A familiar object around machinery and long journeys.
item.darkwinter.gravel_surface.descripti: Fine stone fill with a coarse, grainy face. Familiar surfacing in yards and along side roads.
item.darkwinter.guardrail_corner.descrip: A bent section of steel guardrail. Its rigid outline carries the roadside boundary around a corner.
item.darkwinter.guardrail_section.descri: A shaped steel section of roadside guardrail. A long metal line along the edge of the route.
A short, low section of horizontal boards. A few quiet lines along the edge of a plot.
A long, low section with horizontal boards. Timber strips follow an open boundary.
item.darkwinter.horizontal_fence_tall_1m: A narrow, tall section of crosswise boards. Its repeated horizontal lines resemble plain timber cladding.
item.darkwinter.horizontal_fence_tall_2m: A broad, tall timber fence section. Long horizontal boards give the yard a level, enclosed edge.
item.darkwinter.horizontal_gate_low_clea: A low frame for a narrow opening in a board fence. The horizontal lines stop at a familiar entrance.
A low timber frame around a broad entrance. A generous opening remains between its supports.
item.darkwinter.horizontal_gate_tall_cle: Tall timber posts frame a narrow entrance. Horizontal boards emphasise the upright opening.
A tall board-built frame with a broad opening. Plain, straight lines give the entrance a substantial outline.
item.darkwinter.hospital_bed.description: A narrow metal bed with a plain mattress. Even in an empty ward, it carries the quiet weight of waiting.
item.darkwinter.hospital_gurney.descript: A metal gurney on small wheels. Its long frame brings hospital corridors to mind.
item.darkwinter.junction_box.description: A small metal junction-box case. An unobtrusive piece of a network hidden among walls and poles.
item.darkwinter.juniper_bush.description: A low, prickly juniper with dark berries among its needles. Even a small bush looks tough and stubborn.
Prickly juniper twigs without their dark berries. Only the dense, muted green of the needles remains.
item.darkwinter.kerosene_lantern.descrip: A metal lantern with guarded glass and a carrying handle. An old-fashioned shape with nothing unnecessary about it.
item.darkwinter.kitchen_sink.description: A kitchen sink with a deep basin and tap. Its plain shape recalls the most ordinary household chores.
item.darkwinter.kitchen_stove.descriptio: A kitchen stove with burners and a broad front. Its appearance alone brings an ordinary hot supper to mind.
item.darkwinter.lingonberry_patch.descri: A low lingonberry plant with firm leaves and red berries. A small bright patch on the forest floor.
item.darkwinter.lingonberry_patch_no_ber: Firm lingonberry leaves without their bright fruit. The small plant blends into the forest floor.
item.darkwinter.litter_bag.description: A gathered refuse bag. An unremarkable object, familiar beside almost any occupied building.
item.darkwinter.log_pile.description: Spruce logs gathered into a neat pile. That kind of order among the woods is unmistakably human.
item.darkwinter.low_cabinet.description: A low wooden cabinet with plain doors. Unassuming household furniture, familiar against a wall.
item.darkwinter.mailbox.description: A metal street mailbox. A small part of the distance letters once travelled in people's place.
item.darkwinter.manhole_cover.descriptio: A heavy round cover with a textured face. An unobtrusive boundary between the street and what lies beneath.
item.darkwinter.matchbox.description: A small matchbox with a striker along its side. An unassuming case for something carefully kept away from damp.
item.darkwinter.medical_cabinet.descript: A plain metal cabinet from a medical room. Straight lines and cold surfaces offer little homely comfort.
item.darkwinter.medical_cart.description: A compact medical cart with shelves and wheels. A practical shape made to keep essentials close.
item.darkwinter.metal_bucket.description: An ordinary metal bucket with a wire handle. A plain household object, easier to find than to do without.
item.darkwinter.metal_crate.description: A square metal crate with rigid sides. It looks at home on a journey that was seldom gentle.
item.darkwinter.metal_toolbox.descriptio: A rigid steel box with a lid and handle. A familiar shape for the small things that keep larger jobs moving.
item.darkwinter.newspaper_kiosk.descript: A small street kiosk with a broad front. The kind of place that brings the rustle of fresh paper to mind.
item.darkwinter.northern_campfire.descri: Logs gathered within a ring of stones. The simple, recognisable centre of a woodland camp.
item.darkwinter.oat_carton.description: A cardboard carton of oats. Something about it belongs to a quiet morning before the journey begins.
item.darkwinter.old_fridge.description: A tall refrigerator with a substantial case. A familiar kitchen object, oddly quiet against the winter outside.
item.darkwinter.old_tv.description: A television with a curved screen and deep case. Dark glass makes the absence of evening programmes feel more noticeable.
item.darkwinter.oval_bucket.description: A broad oval bucket with a practical, substantial shape. Its proportions speak of everyday work.
item.darkwinter.oxygen_cylinder.descript: A tall metal cylinder with a valve. A reminder of places where steady breathing matters more than words.
item.darkwinter.pallet_stack.description: Wooden pallets stacked one above another. The plain geometry of loads, deliveries and work seldom noticed.
item.darkwinter.park_bench.description: Wooden slats on solid supports. A bench for a brief pause along a street where few now linger.
item.darkwinter.park_notice_board.descri: A wooden board for notices and directions. A place where an unfamiliar trail would usually acquire a name.
item.darkwinter.paving_slab_block.descri: Even paving slabs. Their joints retain the neat pattern of an ordinary yard.
item.darkwinter.phone_booth.description: A narrow telephone booth with a familiar enclosed shape. A small space once separating an important call from street noise.
item.darkwinter.picket_fence_low_1m.desc: A short, low picket section. Upright slats mark a yard boundary while leaving the street in view.
item.darkwinter.picket_fence_low_2m.desc: A long, low picket section with closely spaced slats. A familiar timber rhythm along an open yard.
item.darkwinter.picket_fence_tall_1m.des: A narrow, tall picket section. Upright timber slats rise into a close-set screen.
item.darkwinter.picket_fence_tall_2m.des: A broad, tall picket section. Its long row of slats gives the yard boundary a firm outline.
item.darkwinter.picket_gate_low_clear_1m: A low timber gate frame with a narrow opening. The space between its posts gives the yard a familiar entrance.
item.darkwinter.picket_gate_low_clear_2m: A low frame around a broad opening in a picket fence. A plain timber outline at either side of the entrance.
item.darkwinter.picket_gate_tall_clear_1: A tall gate frame in a timber picket fence. Raised posts emphasise the narrow opening between them.
item.darkwinter.picket_gate_tall_clear_2: A tall timber frame around a broad opening. The substantial outline of an entrance to an enclosed yard.
item.darkwinter.pipe_rack.description: A metal rack holding lengths of pipe. It has the familiar order of a yard where every piece has its place.
item.darkwinter.privacy_screen.descripti: A hospital screen on metal supports. A thin partition for the moments when a little privacy matters.
item.darkwinter.radiator.description: A row of heavy cast-iron sections. Familiar enough to recall the smell of mittens left to dry.
item.darkwinter.ration_bundle.descriptio: Several ration packs gathered into one bundle. The order of someone accustomed to thinking ahead.
item.darkwinter.road_barrier.description: A road barrier on steady supports. The familiar boundary between a usual route and a closed stretch ahead.
item.darkwinter.road_delineator.descript: A slim marker for the edge of a road. Its spare outline makes the route's direction easier to read.
item.darkwinter.road_sign_stop.descripti: A red octagon on a tall post. A sign recognised before there is time to read it.
item.darkwinter.road_sign_warning.descri: A warning sign on a metal post. A familiar request to leave a little confidence behind before the next bend.
item.darkwinter.rock_scatter.description: Several small stones scattered across the ground. An uneven patch the eye does not always catch.
item.darkwinter.rolled_newspapers.descri: Newspapers rolled into short tubes. Their paper edges hold the shape left by hurried hands.
item.darkwinter.rosehip_bush.description: Thorny wild-rose branches carry reddish hips. The slender bush asks for more room than it first appears to need.
Slender, thorny wild-rose branches without hips. The empty spaces between them stand out against snow.
item.darkwinter.rusty_barrel.description: A steel drum with raised reinforcing rings. A familiar outline in yards, garages and the far end of a warehouse.
item.darkwinter.rusty_workbench.descript: A heavy steel workbench with a broad top. Its rough outline belongs among oil, shavings and patient work.
item.darkwinter.sleeping_bag_folded.desc: A sleeping bag folded into a soft, even bundle. Its neat shape recalls packing before departure.
item.darkwinter.sleeping_bag_roll.descri: A sleeping bag rolled into a tight bundle. A familiar piece of camp kit that brings a rest stop to mind.
item.darkwinter.sleeping_bag_sack.descri: A bulky sack holding a sleeping bag. Its gathered fabric looks at home among the belongings of a long journey.
item.darkwinter.snowy_shrub.description: A low shrub with closely woven twigs. Its outline nearly disappears against the ground.
item.darkwinter.spruce_stump.description: A low spruce stump with rough bark. A small, solid mark where a trunk once reached upward.
item.darkwinter.steel_locker.description: A narrow steel locker with a solid door. A familiar sight in changing rooms, workshops and shift corridors.
item.darkwinter.storage_shelf.descriptio: An open storage rack with level shelves. A simple frame that makes any corner look like a storeroom.
item.darkwinter.street_bicycle_rack.desc: A row of metal bicycle stands. A street detail that would look far more at home in summer.
item.darkwinter.street_lamp.description: A tall street lamp on a metal post. Its outline lends a familiar shape even to an empty street.
item.darkwinter.test_snowy_grass_slab.de: A low layer of earth with grass beneath the snow. A small step in the natural ground.
item.darkwinter.test_spruce_bough.descri: A spruce bough with dense needles and resting snow. Its fine lines nearly vanish beneath their white burden.
item.darkwinter.test_spruce_log.descript: A northern spruce trunk with rough, dark bark. A slender forest shape accustomed to wind and snow.
item.darkwinter.tied_newspapers.descript: A stack of newspapers tied with string. So much once-fresh news gathered into one quiet bundle.
item.darkwinter.timber_boardwalk.descrip: A low walkway of closely laid planks. A plain timber path sitting close to the ground.
A plank walkway raised on timber supports. A visible gap remains beneath its level surface.
item.darkwinter.timber_boardwalk_slab.de: A plank walkway on timber supports. The deck sits half a block above the ground.
item.darkwinter.traffic_cone.description: A bright traffic cone with a broad base. A simple warning, easily recognised from a distance.
item.darkwinter.trash_bin.description: A sturdy street bin. A modest detail of a place once tended as part of an ordinary routine.
item.darkwinter.utility_pole.description: A tall wooden pole with a crossarm and insulators. These upright shapes tie the road to distant homes.
item.darkwinter.vacuum_flask.description: A metal vacuum flask with a cup-shaped cap. A small reminder of hot tea during a long journey.
item.darkwinter.ventilation_unit.descrip: A ventilation housing with a grille. A solid piece of a building, usually noticed only when everything is quiet.
item.darkwinter.waiting_chair.descriptio: A plain chair from a waiting room. The sort that makes every passing minute feel longer.
item.darkwinter.wall_lamp.description: A compact lamp on a wall bracket. A familiar outline beside a door, welcome on the way home.
item.darkwinter.wall_mailbox.description: A small mailbox made for the wall beside an entrance. A plain detail of a home where news was once expected.
item.darkwinter.wall_segment.description: Spruce boards assembled into a wall section. Pale timber and straight joints recall a plain, well-made house.
item.darkwinter.water_bottle.description: A bottle with a narrow neck and screw cap. One of the most ordinary shapes in a traveller's kit.
item.darkwinter.weathered_floor_segment_: Wide spruce boards with a warm tone and a matte oil finish.
Pale grey boards assembled into a floor section. Their subdued surface recalls many ordinary days beneath one roof.
A painted plank floor section. A simple way of lending a familiar room a little order.
A floor section pieced from mixed boards. Its irregular pattern looks familiar in a home repaired as the need arose.
item.darkwinter.weathered_wall_segment_d: A wall section made of dark boards. The timber's deep colour gives even a plain surface a stern character.
item.darkwinter.weathered_wall_segment_g: A wall of pale, weathered boards. Its quiet grey face carries the character of a building long lived in.
item.darkwinter.weathered_wall_segment_p: A painted timber wall section. Even plain boards retain a trace of the everyday care given to a home.
A wall section pieced together from mixed boards. Its uneven pattern suggests making careful use of what was available.
item.darkwinter.weight_0_5kg.description: A small metal weight. It feels more substantial in the hand than it looks from a distance.
item.darkwinter.weight_10kg.description: A massive, dense metal weight. A small object that earns a great deal of attention from the shoulders.
item.darkwinter.weight_1kg.description: A compact metal weight with a plain outline. Nothing unnecessary, only a very noticeable heft.
item.darkwinter.weight_2kg.description: A solid metal weight. Modest in size, but it makes its presence felt in a load.
item.darkwinter.weight_5kg.description: A heavy metal weight. The sort of object remembered whenever a pack is lifted.
item.darkwinter.wheelchair.description: A metal chair with large side wheels. Familiar hospital equipment with a purpose no ordinary chair can share.
item.darkwinter.wire_mesh_fence_low_1m.d: A short, low section of dark wire mesh. Its fine weave marks a boundary without hiding the view.
item.darkwinter.wire_mesh_fence_low_2m.d: A long, low section of graphite-coloured mesh. Its many metal cells remain almost transparent to the eye.
A narrow, tall mesh fence section. A dark metal frame holds the even wire weave.
A broad, tall section of wire mesh. The far side remains visible through its orderly pattern of cells.
item.darkwinter.wire_mesh_gate_low_clear: A low metal frame for a narrow opening in mesh. The spare outline of a familiar yard entrance.
A low mesh frame with a broad opening. Its dark metal leaves the surrounding yard in view.
item.darkwinter.wire_mesh_gate_tall_clea: A tall metal frame surrounds a narrow opening. Closely woven dark mesh extends along either side.
A tall mesh frame with a spacious entrance. Plain metal outlines the opening while leaving the view largely clear.
item.darkwinter.wooden_chair.description: A wooden chair with a straight back. So familiar that its absence is easier to notice than its presence.
item.darkwinter.wooden_wardrobe.descript: A tall wooden wardrobe with broad doors. Its solid outline makes a room look lived in.
item.darkwinter.worn_sofa.description: A plain upholstered sofa with a broad seat. Its outline alone makes a room feel a little less unfamiliar.
item.darkwinter.writing_desk.description: A writing desk with a level top. A place for papers and quiet work, forever interrupted by something more urgent.
item.darkwinter.hiking_backpack.descript: Tighten the straps, settle the weight, and head out. This pack tolerates some damp, though a dry place under a roof is always better.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_northern_wande: Leather, straps, and a tightly rolled bedroll. A noticeable pull on the shoulders; it resists some damp, but belongs in a dry corner at night.
item.darkwinter.cotton_tshirt.descriptio: Thin cotton is barely felt beneath a coat. A little warmth against the skin; facing the wind in this T-shirt alone is a poor idea.
item.darkwinter.navy_tshirt.description: Navy cotton slips easily beneath warmer layers. Free to move in, but the shirt brings only a little warmth and no shelter from the weather.
item.darkwinter.red_tshirt.description: A little red among the winter layers. Light warmth and easy movement; let the coat deal with wind and damp.
item.darkwinter.olive_wool_sweater.descr: Dense olive wool brings warmth without a tight fit. Best beneath a coat: wind passes through the knit, and the wool needs shelter from damp.
item.darkwinter.navy_wool_sweater.descri: Dark wool brings welcome warmth under a closed coat. The sweater has some heft but leaves movement free; it cannot face the weather alone.
item.darkwinter.ochre_fleece.description: Soft ochre fleece sits easily beneath a coat. Less warmth than a wool sweater, but less weight too; wind still calls for an outer layer.
item.darkwinter.red_flannel_shirt.descri: Soft flannel recalls the warmth of a room. On the trail it adds only a little heat, with little burden; weather still calls for a coat.
item.darkwinter.jacket.description: A jacket for an ordinary cold day: zip up and go. Moderate warmth and little restriction, though rough weather will test it.
item.darkwinter.winter_parka.description: A heavy parka for a long, frozen road. Strong against wind, less against damp; swinging your arms freely is no longer an option.
item.darkwinter.work_pants.description: Work cloth leaves your stride almost untouched. A little warmth, but an exposed or damp trail soon calls for more protection.
item.darkwinter.winter_pants.description: The lining makes a winter road warmer without much restriction. There is more weight now, but still little defence against wind and damp.
item.darkwinter.red_expedition_parka.des: A red parka for crossings where the wind never settles. Very warm and well sheltered, with bulk and weight felt in every movement.
item.darkwinter.navy_down_parka.descript: Down holds exceptional warmth in dry cold. A heavy, restrictive parka; damp is a much greater weakness than wind.
item.darkwinter.ochre_anorak.description: An ochre shell for a wind-scoured road. Good protection without too much weight, but less warmth than an everyday jacket.
item.darkwinter.quilted_work_jacket.desc: Quilting brings extra warmth without a parka's weight. A little tighter through the shoulders; damp weather is not this work jacket's friend.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_northern_wande: A scarf rests over a warm winter jacket. Reassuring in the wind, with weight and a snug cut felt in motion; damp is best avoided.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_expedition_par: A bulky parka made to be fastened before stepping into the open. Very warm and strong against wind, though never light to travel in.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_quilted_field_: A heavy field jacket holds warmth between quilted seams. Fairly easy to move in, but offering little shelter from damp weather.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_fur_collar_col: A fur collar frames a warm jacket for frozen roads. Its substantial bulk stands up to wind, but restricts movement and fares poorly in damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_military_winte: The heavy skirts of this winter coat discourage haste. Dense cloth holds warmth and keeps off wind; damp is another matter.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_workwear_insul: A warm work jacket for a day outdoors. It takes some damp in stride, though its weight and snug cut are felt once it is time to move.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_long_anorak.de: Long hems offer good shelter from wind and some from damp. A heavy garment, with more bulk and restriction than its warmth might suggest.
This heavy bomber still leaves room to move. Good against wind and moderately warm, with damp weather revealing its weakness.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_survival_shell: A dense shell for bitter wind and wet snow. Strong protection outside, modest warmth within; weight and a tight feel come with it.
item.darkwinter.olive_cargo_pants.descri: Olive cargos leave room for your usual stride. A little warmth for an ordinary road, but limited help against exposed wind and damp.
item.darkwinter.navy_thermal_pants.descr: A warm winter lining lies beneath navy cloth. Heavier than work trousers, with an almost free stride, but modest weather protection.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_northern_wande: Winter cargos for a steady, measured stride. Good warmth with slight restriction; better at facing wind than damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_cargo_winter_t: Substantial cargos for the road between winter shelters. Generous warmth for their layer, a slightly restricted stride, and little love of damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_insulated_fiel: Warmth for a winter road lies beneath the dense cloth. The insulation limits a free stride, while damp remains a weakness.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_padded_snow_pa: Bulky trousers for the road through snow. Warm and moderately weather-resistant, with heavy padding that calls for more measured movement.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_technical_shel: A dense shell faces wind and wet snow well. Little warmth inside, with noticeable weight and restriction: weather protection comes first.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_reinforced_wor: Dense work cloth stands up well to wind. Heavier than plain work trousers and a little restrictive, with only a small gain in warmth.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_bib_overalls.d: Winter bibs for hours in the cold. Dense insulation brings warmth and shelter from wind, at the cost of an easy, open stride.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_quilted_expedi: Thick quilting brings the most warmth of any trousers. Reassuring in lasting cold; a heavy compromise for free movement or damp weather.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_rugged_scout_p: Trousers for a long road taken without haste. Moderate warmth and weather protection, with an almost free stride despite their weight.
item.darkwinter.knit_cap.description: Light knitting brings a little warmth, barely felt on the head. Welcome in still cold; wind easily finds its way between the loops.
item.darkwinter.fur_hat.description: Fur brings more warmth than a plain knit. Reassuring in wind, with a noticeable weight and closed fit; damp is no friend to it.
item.darkwinter.red_watch_cap.descriptio: Red knitting makes a small warm spot in winter. Light and easy, but the loops are no wall against wind and give no defence against damp.
item.darkwinter.navy_earflap_hat.descrip: A navy ushanka shelters the ears on a cold road. Ample warmth and noticeable weight, with some wind cover and much less defence against damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_northern_wande: Heavier than a plain knit suggests, with only modest warmth. Easy to wear; out in the wind, a hood would be welcome.
Deep knitted ribs, noticeable weight, and modest warmth. Easy to wear, but wind and damp readily find their way through.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_fold_over_watc: A broad fold adds warmth where it meets the forehead. Not a light hat; the knit still lets in wind and offers no defence against damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_ushanka.descri: A warm ushanka for a frozen road. Its weight and closed fit add slight restriction; it faces wind more confidently than damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_trapper_hat.de: A warm hat with a dense outer layer for a long day outside. Better against weather than a plain fur hat, but more restrictive in its fit.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_thick_knit_ear: Soft knitted flaps cover the ears, bringing warmth without a tight fit. Substantial in weight, but still in need of shelter from wind and damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_balaclava_and_: Soft cloth beneath the cap adds some warmth without restriction. Better against wind than a plain knit, but only a little better against damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_fur_lined_stor: A fur-lined storm cap for places where the wind never settles. Very warm and enclosed; reassurance in the cold comes with weight and restriction.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_low_profile_wi: A low field cap leaves movement free. Little warmth, but its dense outer layer meets wind and light damp better than a plain knit.
item.darkwinter.wool_gloves.description: Light wool warms the hands in still weather. Easy to move in, but wind passes between the loops and the knit cannot hold off damp.
item.darkwinter.winter_mittens.descripti: Plump winter mittens bring welcome warmth on a cold road. Some shelter from wind, with weight and restriction arriving alongside the warmth.
item.darkwinter.leather_work_gloves.desc: Thin leather leaves movement free and adds little weight. Some shelter from weather, but very little to offer in bitter cold.
item.darkwinter.fleece_gloves.descriptio: Soft fleece sits lightly on the hands with a little warmth. Best in calm weather: wind passes almost freely, and there is no defence against damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_northern_wande: Warm gloves for a long winter road. Their weight is felt and movement is slightly less free; wind is easier for them than damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_knit_liner_glo: Substantial knitted gloves offer only light warmth. Free to move in, but heavier than a plain pair and helpless against damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_leather_work_g: These leather work gloves feel substantial, but fit freely. Better at facing wind and light damp than cold; there is almost no insulation.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_insulated_wint: A warm winter layer hides beneath the dense outer fabric. Slightly restrictive gloves, more reassuring in wind than in damp weather.
Fur-lined mittens for cold that makes you hide your hands. Very warm and good against wind, though their bulk noticeably limits movement.
The split-finger cut leaves more freedom than closed mittens. Less warmth, but a more confident defence against wind and light damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_tactical_cold_: Winter gloves without the usual restriction. Moderate warmth; the dense outer layer offers more shelter from wind than from damp.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_canvas_gauntle: Long canvas cuffs stand up well to wind. Slightly restrictive gloves with modest warmth and little liking for damp weather.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_waterproof_she: Gloves for wind and wet snow. Moderate warmth beneath a protective shell, with a dense construction that costs some freedom of movement.
item.darkwinter.work_boots.description: Dense work boots make the stride heavier. Some shelter from weather, but little warmth to offer a serious winter.
item.darkwinter.winter_boots.description: Heavy boots for a frozen road. Warm inside and good against wind; dense insulation comes at the cost of a free stride.
item.darkwinter.insulated_work_boots.des: Work boots with a warm lining and dense outer layer. Good against wind, but heavy and restrictive; ordinary winter boots are warmer.
item.darkwinter.leather_hiking_boots.des: Leather boots for roads that carry on beyond the next bend. Freer to walk in than work boots, but with little warmth and modest damp resistance.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_northern_wande: Warm winter boots with weight felt in every stride. Good against wind and some damp; their dense build calls for measured movement.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_expedition_sno: Heavy boots for long crossings with nowhere to hide from wind. Very warm and well sheltered, but never a recipe for a light stride.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_lace_up_work_b: Tight laces draw heavy work boots around the foot. Moderate weather protection, with less warmth inside than their solid look suggests.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_insulated_rubb: Thick rubber keeps out nearly all wet and stands up to wind. Moderate warmth, with weight and density that noticeably restrict the stride.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_tactical_winte: Winter boots built for movement, though far from light. Moderate warmth, good wind protection, and more freedom than ordinary winter boots.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_heavy_mountain: Rigid, heavy boots for cold, exposed ground. Good weather protection, paid for with the most restricted stride of any footwear.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_felt_lined_fie: Thick felt holds warmth in dry, bitter cold. Heavy boots that limit a free stride; damp remains the warm lining's weakness.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_reinforced_sur: Dense trail boots for wind and damp roads. More impressive in protection than warmth; their heavy build noticeably restricts the stride.
item.darkwinter.cinematic_fur_lined_cold: A fur lining promises warmth on a dry, frozen road. Heavy, restrictive boots; wind troubles them less than damp.
item.darkwinter.wool_socks.description: A little soft wool warmth inside the boots. Light and easy to move in; shelter from wind and damp must come from the footwear.
item.darkwinter.insulated_socks.descript: A warm layer between foot and winter boot. Heavier than plain wool, without restriction; keeping dry is still the footwear's job.
item.darkwinter.thick_hiking_socks.descr: Dense knitting for a long road, with warmth starting at the feet. Heavier than plain wool socks; the boots must take care of damp.
item.darkwinter.canned_corn.description: Yellow kernels beneath a tin lid. A small store of summer on a cold house's shelf.
item.darkwinter.canned_peas.description: Ordinary green peas from a household cupboard. Once, a tin like this was opened for supper without a thought for tomorrow.
item.darkwinter.canned_tomatoes.descript: Canned tomatoes with a familiar, rich scent. A reminder of a kitchen where someone used to wait for supper.
item.darkwinter.canned_peaches.descripti: Soft peaches in sweet syrup. A modest treat from days when the cupboard always seemed to fill again.
item.darkwinter.canned_mushroom_soup.des: Thick mushroom soup beneath a tin lid. The familiar smell of a simple meal at home.
item.darkwinter.canned_chicken_noodle_so: Chicken soup with soft noodles. A tin like this used to wait in the cupboard for the end of a long day.
item.darkwinter.peanut_butter.descriptio: Thick peanut butter with a rich, nutty scent. A spoon leaves a stubborn furrow through it.
item.darkwinter.berry_jam.description: Dark, sweet jam with the scent of berries. Something of the short northern summer lingers in it.
item.darkwinter.condensed_milk.descripti: Thick, sweet milk. A flavour difficult to mistake for anything else, even after many years.
item.darkwinter.processed_cheese.descrip: Soft processed cheese with a familiar creamy scent. Plain food for a plain sandwich.
item.darkwinter.salted_peanuts.descripti: Dry peanuts dusted with salt. A familiar crunch that once helped pass the miles.
item.darkwinter.beef_jerky.description: Dark, dense strips of beef. Dried meat with the smell of long roads and carefully packed provisions.
item.darkwinter.granola_bar.description: Grains and flakes held together by sweetness. A familiar snack, easily forgotten at the bottom of a pack.
item.darkwinter.potato_chips.description: Thin, salted potato slices. Their loud crunch sounds out of place in an empty house.
item.darkwinter.smoked_sausage.descripti: Firm sausage with a smoky scent. Pale flecks of fat show across the cut surface.
item.darkwinter.chocolate_bar.descriptio: A dark bar divided into neat squares. Breaking one off still feels like something worth doing carefully.
item.darkwinter.wafers.description: Brittle wafers with thin layers of filling. Crumbs cling to the fingers at the slightest touch.
item.darkwinter.oatmeal_cookies.descript: Firm oatmeal cookies with uneven crusts. Their scent recalls a kitchen table and an unhurried cup of tea.
item.darkwinter.energy_bar.description: A dense, sweet bar from a store of trail provisions. Something once set aside for an especially long journey.
item.darkwinter.instant_noodles.descript: Dry noodles pressed into a brittle block. A familiar standby for evenings when nobody felt like cooking.
item.darkwinter.potato_flakes.descriptio: Pale, dry potato flakes. A modest cupboard staple waiting to become a meal.
item.darkwinter.corn_flakes.description: Light, golden flakes of corn. A crisp reminder of an ordinary morning among the provisions.
item.darkwinter.cola.description: Dark, sweet soda with a familiar spiced scent. Once bought for a drive without ever counting it as a provision.
item.darkwinter.energy_cola.description: A bold cola with a sharp, sweet scent. A reminder of night shifts and the lights of an all-night shop.
item.darkwinter.lemon_lime_soda.descript: Pale soda scented with lemon and lime. A simple flavour familiar from roadside shops.
item.darkwinter.ginger_ale.description: Golden soda with a spicy note of ginger. Bubbles hiss softly at the surface.
item.darkwinter.orange_soda.description: Bright, sweet soda with an orange scent. Its colour looks strange beside the snow beyond the window.
item.darkwinter.root_beer.description: An alcohol-free soda with a rich, spiced aroma. An old, familiar flavour from the local diner.
item.darkwinter.apple_juice.description: Apple juice with a gentle fruity scent. A familiar small detail from breakfasts long past.
item.darkwinter.orange_juice.description: Juice with the tangy scent of orange pulp. A reminder of fruit grown far from these snows.
item.darkwinter.grape_juice.description: Dark juice with a rich grape scent. Held to the light, it shows a deep reddish colour.
item.darkwinter.iced_tea.description: Sweet iced tea in a bottle. A drink meant for very different weather, lost among winter supplies.
item.darkwinter.fruit_drink.description: A sweet fruit drink mixed from powder. The familiar taste of a simple stop along the trail.
item.darkwinter.black_tea.description: Dark tea with the astringent scent of steeped leaves. The aroma of a quiet kitchen and conversations nobody hurried.
item.darkwinter.coffee.description: Coffee with a deep, bitter aroma. The smell of early starts, working shifts and a light above the kitchen table.
item.darkwinter.cocoa.description: Cocoa with a gentle chocolate scent. A memory of another evening when snow fell beyond the window.
item.darkwinter.rosehip_infusion.descrip: An infusion with the tart scent of rosehips. It recalls the fruit left hanging on bare branches.
item.darkwinter.chaga_infusion.descripti: A dark infusion with a woody scent. Something of a quiet birch wood lingers in its earthy flavour.
item.darkwinter.cranberry_drink.descript: A red drink with a sharp berry tang. Even its scent recalls low plants close to damp ground.
item.darkwinter.lingonberry_drink.descri: A drink with the tart scent of lingonberries. A small reminder of berries found beneath the snow.
